/api/v0/events.description: Server-to-client JSON envelopes only; hello, catalog and terminals baseline first. Contiguous seq starts at 1 on each connection. Catalog changes precede attention. Reconnect replaces the baseline without replay. Client data closes with 4400. See ui-api.md.

/api/v0/terminal.description: One JSON envelope per text message. hello first; open before frame; operation_sequence and applied reset/output checkpoints govern mutations. See mobile-protocol.md.
